notes: www.sostrenegrene.com is a country-picker splash page (no www redirect content); the live site serves per-locale paths under sostrenegrene.com/<locale>/. Used the English (en-gb) locale (sitemap: sostrenegrene.com/en-gb/sitemap.xml) per rules S11 - content is native English there, no translation needed. Site is a client-rendered SPA (Vue/Umbraco commerce); category pages carry no product data in the raw server HTML, so exact qty was read via rendered-page visible 'N PRODUCTS' counters, cross-checked against the site's own /umbraco/api/catalog/search JSON response (field 'total') for every row - both sources matched exactly on all 33 pages checked. robots.txt (sostrenegrene.com/robots.txt) has no Claude-specific disallow (User-agent:* Allow:/). Discovery: inspected en-gb sitemap.xml (full category tree, all -c-NNNN PLP slugs) plus the site's headernavigation API (umbraco/api/siteinfo/headernavigation) for the live English mega-menu. Two genuine seasonal branches found: Christmas (root products/christmas-c-8574) and Easter (root products/easter-c-10507); both are real, currently-live PLPs with real per-category product counts, not landing/marketing pages (confirmed via rendered product grids and matching API totals). Checked and found NO genuine category for Halloween, Valentine's Day, New Year, Thanksgiving, Diwali/other Indian festivals, or a generic 'Seasonal'/'Festive' root: sitemap search for halloween/valentine/new-year/thanksgiving/diwali under /products/ returned zero category (-c-) URLs, only isolated PDP product pages (e.g. one 'new-years-eve-party-goggles' product, a few 'spring'/'summer'-named individual products) which do not constitute categories per rules S5-S6. The only Halloween-related page found is /en-gb/inspiration/halloween, an editorial/inspiration page, not a PLP - excluded per rules S4/S17. 'Gifts' (products/gifts-c-21007, 213 products) is a general, non-seasonal gift category (its own meta description is generic, no date/holiday reference) and was excluded entirely; however two of its children carry a genuine Christmas ambiguity and are flagged rather than silently included or excluded - see 'Stocking Fillers' rows below and qa_notes.md. Parent nodes whose children are subsets of the parent's own listing (Christmas root, Easter root, Christmas Gift Wrapping, Christmas Gifts, Easter Decorations, Stocking Fillers) are recorded as is_group grouping rows (qty/link blank) per rules S9, with their own aggregate 'N PRODUCTS' figure noted in evidence for reference only - not used as a leaf qty.
